data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (from/to, date, passengers/class, confirm, show flights, select fare) and splits passengers into counts. It adds a one-way trip step, restricts cabin to Economy or Premium, and is vague on the fare-selection step, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
